# Pung Table

> Pung Table (pungtable.com, sometimes written PungTable) is a free online mahjong website. Players can play mahjong in a web browser against friends, other players, or computer opponents, with no download.

## Games
- Riichi mahjong (Japanese rules): https://pungtable.com/rules/riichi
- Taiwanese 16-tile mahjong: https://pungtable.com/rules/taiwanese
- Bombay mahjong (Indian style, with jokers): https://pungtable.com/rules/bombay
- International mahjong (the Australian club game with named special hands): https://pungtable.com/rules/international
- American mahjong (National Mah Jongg League style: Charleston, jokers, a card of hands; Pung Table's own card): https://pungtable.com/rules/american

## Features
- Quick match: join a table in seconds (https://pungtable.com/quick/riichi)
- Play with friends using a table code
- Practice: a three-hand skill test with a report on strengths and weaknesses (https://pungtable.com/practice)
- The Dragon: an AI mahjong coach that answers rules and strategy questions and reviews finished games (https://pungtable.com/ask)
- Leaderboard of online wins
- Free to play
